system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: listed automatically in the agent's system prompts via the `{{.UserFiles}}` template variable, which renders a compact `<task_files>` XML block
system_prompt_style.note: Template variables plus per-agent prompt templates editable in Settings -> Prompts.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Vector Store: PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search and memory storage
env_context_strategy.note: Embedding retrieval plus knowledge graph context injected, while agents also explore via shell/search tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The chain summarization system manages conversation context growth by selectively summarizing older messages.
context_compaction.note: Enabled by default via SUMMARIZER_* settings.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Inspect tool activity and terminal output as the flow runs
observation_format.note: Scraper returns page text; no evidence of image observations being passed to the model.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Tool Calling: Robust function calling across all models for pentesting tool orchestration

tool_count.note: README cites '20+ professional security tools' inside the container but does not enumerate the LLM-facing tool schemas.

edit_primitive.note: No edit-tool definition in the supplied evidence; file changes appear to go through shell commands but this is not shown.

tool_schema_source.note: Schema-producing code not included in evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: **MCP server management**: MCP settings pages are not currently exposed as a live web-console feature.
protocol_standardization.note: MCP servers exist as server-side configuration; only the web UI page is absent.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Planner (adviser in planning mode) generates 3-7 specific, actionable steps before specialist agents begin work
loop_primitives.note: react is the default loop; planning is opt-in via AGENT_PLANNING_STEP_ENABLED (default false).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
Flow ||--o{ Task : contains
Task ||--o{ SubTask : contains
planning_granularity.note: Tasks/subtasks are persisted DB entities with status fields.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Delegation system with specialized AI agents for research, development, and infrastructure tasks
multi_agent_topology.note: Orchestrator delegates to researcher/developer/executor roles in Automation mode.

delegation_mechanism.note: Subtasks carry an agent_type; orchestrator hands each subtask to a specialist role.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Use the assistant to check flow status, stop the current task, submit follow-up instructions, or patch the remaining planned subtasks before the next step runs.
human_in_loop.note: Automation mode runs autonomously; Assistant mode gives interactive steering.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Smart Memory System. Long-term storage of research results and successful approaches for future use.
long_term_memory.note: pgvector store plus Graphiti/Neo4j knowledge graph of past actions.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: All commands and outputs are stored in PostgreSQL
state_persistence.note: Flows are persisted and can be reopened and steered; explicit resume code not in evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Progress Analysis**: Evaluates whether agent advances toward subtask objective, detects loops and inefficiencies
self_verification.note: Adviser/mentor and reflector review agent behaviour; monitoring off by default (EXECUTION_MONITOR_ENABLED=false).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Automatic Correction**: Invoked when LLM fails to generate tool calls after 3 attempts
retry_policy.note: Only step-level correction; no whole-flow retry policy documented.

rollback.evidence_quote: Editing a snapshot in the UI does not write back into the running container.
rollback.note: No undo/revert/snapshot-restore mechanism documented for agent changes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: General agents (Assistant, Primary Agent, Pentester, Coder, Installer): `MAX_GENERAL_AGENT_TOOL_CALLS` (default: 100)
termination_condition.note: Barrier tools `done`/`ask` give model-declared termination; tool-call caps always active.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Prompt Caching**: Cost reduction on repeated context (10-50% of input price)
cost_controls.note: Per-agent model assignment exists in provider configs but is static, not content-based routing.

timeouts.note: Only per-service/request timeouts (scraper, Graphiti, model pulls) documented; no run-level wall clock.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Secure & Isolated. All operations are performed in a sandboxed Docker environment with complete isolation.
execution_isolation.note: Optional two-node setup moves worker containers to a dedicated host.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: uploaded files are also pushed into it at `/work/uploads/` so the agent can read them with normal shell tools
filesystem_access.note: Coded relative to the container boundary; snapshots can be pulled from any container path e.g. /etc/...

network_policy.evidence_quote: `PROXY_URL` is a global proxy URL for all LLM providers and external search systems. You can use it for isolation from external networks.
network_policy.note: Proxy applies to LLM/search traffic; no egress allowlist for agent actions documented.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Fully Autonomous. AI-powered agent that automatically determines and executes penetration testing steps
permission_model.note: No per-action authorisation or allow/blocklist layer documented; scope is expressed in the prompt only.

tracing.evidence_quote: OpenTelemetry: Unified observability data collection and correlation
tracing.note: Requires running docker-compose-observability.yml; Langfuse adds LLM-level traces.

replayability.evidence_quote: All commands and outputs are stored in PostgreSQL with [pgvector](https://hub.docker.com/r/vxcontrol/pgvector) extension.
replayability.note: Full history is recorded and viewable; no replay runner documented.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: PentAGI today is an autonomous and assistant-guided penetration testing platform, not a CALDERA-style Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS) or adversary emulation product with predefined campaigns or attack plans.
eval_hooks.note: Repo ships ctester/etester/ftester developer harnesses for LLM, embedding and function testing, but no benchmark evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Hard Limits**: Prevent runaway executions regardless of supervision mode status
guardrails.note: Limits and reflector-enforced graceful termination constrain actions; no content filters documented.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
target_domain.note: Primary domain is security testing (no exact value in list); web scraper and MCP/tool integration add web and general_tool_use.
